name: C677T (Ala222Val, exon 4)
alleles: Plus strand, GRCh37 (as in 23andMe raw data): G reference, A variant. MTHFR is on the minus strand, so A here is the T of c.665C>T, known as C677T.
effect: Reduces enzyme thermostability. 677TT homozygotes have ~30% of normal MTHFR activity; 677CT heterozygotes ~65% (lymphocyte extracts, Frosst et al., Nat Genet 1995). ClinVar (VCV000003520): aggregate classification drug response (methotrexate toxicity), reviewed by an expert panel; a DPWG review found insufficient evidence for an MTHFR–methotrexate gene–drug interaction (van der Pol et al., Eur J Hum Genet 2024). Submissions for individual conditions conflict.
frequency_note: 677T allele (A on the plus strand) ~37% in Europeans, ~47% in Admixed Americans, ~9% in Africans (1000 Genomes, Ensembl).

sources.label: van der Pol et al., Eur J Hum Genet 2024 (DPWG)

name: *10 (100C>T)
alleles: Plus strand, GRCh37 (as in 23andMe raw data): G reference, A variant. CYP2D6 is on the minus strand, so A here is the T of c.100C>T (Pro34Ser). A is carried by *10 and by many other alleles, *4 among them, so it can't be read as *10 on its own: read it together with rs3892097.
frequency_note: ~40% in East Asians, where it is the dominant intermediate-activity variant. Rare in Europeans.

name: *2 (c.681G>A)
alleles: Plus strand, GRCh37 (as in 23andMe raw data): G reference, A variant, which defines *2. CYP2C19 is on the plus strand, so the letters match the gene. Copies of A at this one position are not a metabolizer status: that needs the other CYP2C19 variants and phasing.
effect: Splice defect, no functional enzyme; the most common CYP2C19 loss-of-function allele worldwide. Poor and intermediate metabolizers form less active clopidogrel.
frequency_note: ~15% in Europeans, ~17% in Africans, ~29–35% in East Asians.

name: *3 (c.636G>A)
alleles: Plus strand, GRCh37 (as in 23andMe raw data): G reference, A variant (Trp212Ter), which defines *3.
effect: Premature stop codon, no functional enzyme.
frequency_note: Rare in Europeans (<1%), common in East Asians (~5–9%).

name: *17 (c.-806C>T)
alleles: Plus strand, GRCh37 (as in 23andMe raw data): C reference, T variant (c.-806C>T), found in *17.
effect: Promoter variant that boosts transcription and raises enzyme activity; drives rapid (*1/*17) and ultra-rapid (*17/*17) metabolizer phenotypes.
frequency_note: ~21% in Europeans, ~16% in Africans, ~3% in East Asians.

name: G6PD A- (component 1 of 2)
alleles: Plus strand, GRCh37 (as in 23andMe raw data): C reference, T variant. G6PD is on the minus strand, so T here is the A of c.202G>A (Val68Met), the change that makes G6PD A- together with c.376A>G (rs1050829). G6PD is on the X chromosome: counting needs the person's sex.
effect: Together with rs1050829 defines the G6PD A- allele: moderately reduced activity, milder than Mediterranean; hemolysis often self-limiting but drug and infection triggers still matter.

name: H63D (p.His63Asp)
alleles: Plus strand, GRCh37 (as in 23andMe raw data): C reference, G variant (His63Asp, H63D). Strand-ambiguous (C/G): the letters are the same on both strands, so you can't tell which strand a file uses, and a homozygote on the other strand reads as the other allele.
effect: Much milder than C282Y. H63D/H63D alone does not cause clinically meaningful iron overload; matters mainly as a compound heterozygote with C282Y.
frequency_note: Far more common worldwide than C282Y.

name: 185delAG (c.68_69delAG)
alleles: An insertion-deletion site, not a single letter: this rsID covers both a two-base deletion (c.68_69del, known as 185delAG) and a duplication at the same place, and consumer files report insertions and deletions in their own notation. It can't be counted from an rsID lookup.
effect: Frameshift that truncates the protein early. ClinVar: Pathogenic. Reported by some consumer services as part of the Ashkenazi founder panel.
frequency_note: Ashkenazi Jewish founder variant; ~1% carrier frequency in that population, far rarer elsewhere.

name: C61G (c.181T>G)
alleles: Plus strand, GRCh37 (as in 23andMe raw data): A reference, C variant. BRCA1 is on the minus strand, so C here is the G of c.181T>G (Cys61Gly).
effect: Missense disrupting the RING domain; abolishes E3 ligase activity. ClinVar: Pathogenic. SNP chips like those consumer tests use are unreliable for rare pathogenic variants: on the research arrays used in UK Biobank, only 4.2% of positive BRCA1/BRCA2 chip calls were confirmed by sequencing (Weedon et al., BMJ 2021), so a chip result needs a validated clinical test.

sources.label: Weedon et al., BMJ 2021 (SNP chips and rare pathogenic variants)
